blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every day at Czarnikow, traders start early. They check prices, call clients and send emails. This is their routine.

We use the Present Simple for routines. I check the market every morning. Ethan calls clients every day. We send reports on Fridays.

She signs contracts on Mondays. They meet buyers in London. The market opens at 9 am. Routine builds fluency.

items.q: What do traders do every day?
options: They open the market at 5 am
They check prices, call clients and send emails
items.why: "They check prices, call clients and send emails." — essa é a rotina diária.

items.q: When does the market open?
items.why: "The market opens at 9 am."

items.q: What tense do we use for routines?
items.why: "We use the Present Simple for routines."

items.q: The text suggests that traders at Czarnikow are…
items.why: Inferência: o texto mostra ações que se repetem todo dia — isso indica uma rotina organizada.

items.q: "Routine builds fluency" suggests that…
options: doing the same things every day helps you learn
items.why: Inferência: rotina (repetir todo dia) ajuda a construir fluência no idioma.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan falando da sua rotina da manhã. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I am Ethan. I work at Czarnikow. Let me tell you about my morning.

Every day, I wake up at six. First, I make coffee. Then I open my computer and I check the market. I look at the sugar prices. This is very important for us.

At nine, the market opens. I call my clients. I ask them about their plans. After the calls, I send emails. I write my emails in English.

On Mondays, my boss signs the contracts. On Fridays, we send reports to London. Sometimes I meet buyers in the office. We talk about sugar and prices.

I like my routine. Routine builds fluency, and it helps me every day. Now, please note my verbs: check, call, send, meet and sign. See you tomorrow!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Ethan make first in the morning?
items.why: "First, I make coffee."

items.q: What does Ethan check on his computer?
options: The market and the sugar prices
items.why: "I check the market. I look at the sugar prices."

items.q: When does Ethan's boss sign the contracts?
items.why: "On Mondays, my boss signs the contracts."

items.q: Ethan says "Routine builds fluency." This suggests he thinks his routine…
items.why: Inferência: ele diz que a rotina ajuda todo dia — vê a rotina como algo positivo para aprender.

items.q: Why does Ethan probably speak English at work?
options: Because he does not know Portuguese
Because he lives in the United States
Because his clients and reports are international
items.why: Inferência: ele escreve emails em inglês e envia relatórios para Londres — o trabalho é internacional.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I check the market every morning." To check means to…
items.why: Check = verificar / checar.

items.q: "Ethan calls his clients every day." To call means to…
items.why: Call = ligar / chamar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We ___ reports to London on Fridays."
items.why: Send = enviar. "We send reports".

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On Mondays, she ___ the new contracts."
items.why: Sign = assinar. Contratos se assinam (sign).

items.q: "They meet buyers in London." To meet means to…
items.why: Meet = encontrar / reunir-se com alguém.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Ethan gets up at six." To get up means to…
options: wake up and leave the bed
items.why: Get up = levantar da cama pela manhã.

items.q: "At nine, the market opens up." To open up means to…
items.why: Open up = abrir, começar a funcionar.

items.q: "The boss has to sign off on the contract." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please send over the report." To send over means to…
items.why: Send over = enviar algo para alguém.

items.q: "Let's catch up after the call." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, conversar para se atualizar.
